description: This PHP source file defines the CorporateDirectoryModuleController class, which manages the server-side logic for a corporate directory module within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It handles service instantiation for job titles and locations, and prepares a Vue.js component with relevant data for rendering.

classes.name: CorporateDirectoryModuleController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for preparing data and rendering the Vue.js component for the corporate directory module.

methods.name: getJobTitleService
methods.description: Returns an instance of JobTitleService, creating it if it does not already exist.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Returns an instance of LocationService, creating it if it does not already exist.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with job titles and locations data before rendering.
